Idea: Restaurant and local business delivery service leveraging last-mile logistics technology.
Description: DoorDash, founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, is a technology company dedicated to transforming local businesses and enabling new ways of working and earning. It connects customers with their favorite local and national restaurants across more than 600 cities in the United States and Canada by building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology.
Takeaway: Building intelligent last-mile delivery technology and a robust marketplace model can enable rapid expansion, empower local businesses, and lead to significant market valuation and a successful public offering.
Reason: The company achieved significant market success, evidenced by its $71 billion valuation in its blockbuster market debut and IPO. This was driven by its ability to scale last-mile delivery technology, expand geographically across the US and Canada, and effectively connect customers with local businesses, transforming local commerce.
Region: United States, Canada (Headquarters in San Francisco)
